metrics.name: class_count
metrics.description: Classes declared in the file; written only when there is one.

metrics.name: cognitive_max
metrics.description: Highest cognitive complexity of any function in the file.

metrics.name: cognitive_sum
metrics.description: Cognitive complexity summed over the file's functions.

metrics.name: cyclomatic_max
metrics.description: Highest cyclomatic complexity of any function in the file.

metrics.name: cyclomatic_sum
metrics.description: Cyclomatic complexity summed over the file's functions.

metrics.name: fan_in
metrics.description: Import and re-export edges into the node. Summing over a group would count its internal edges.

metrics.name: fan_out
metrics.description: Import and re-export edges out of the node. Summing over a group would count its internal edges.

metrics.name: function_count
metrics.description: Functions, methods, and arrow functions declared in the file.

metrics.name: instability
metrics.description: fan_out / (fan_in + fan_out); written only when the node has an import edge.

metrics.name: lcom4_max
metrics.description: Highest LCOM4 of any class in the file; above 1 means the class could split.

metrics.name: linked_test_count
metrics.description: Test files linked to this source. One test can link to several sources, so it does not sum.

metrics.name: loc
metrics.description: Non-blank lines in the file.

metrics.name: loop_depth
metrics.description: Deepest lexical loop nesting; written at 2 or more.

metrics.name: max_nesting_depth
metrics.description: Deepest block nesting inside any function in the file.

metrics.name: recursive_functions
metrics.description: Functions that call themselves by name. TypeScript only.

metrics.name: search_in_loop
metrics.description: Linear searches such as .includes or .find inside a loop. TypeScript only.

metrics.name: symbol_cognitive
metrics.description: Cognitive complexity of the function a symbol names; the max when several functions share the name.

metrics.name: symbol_cyclomatic
metrics.description: Cyclomatic complexity of the function a symbol names; the max when several functions share the name.

metrics.name: unused_params
metrics.description: Trailing parameters never read. TypeScript only.

metrics.name: utilization
metrics.description: Inbound edges weighted by reference count over the barrel-resolved graph: how heavily a node is used.
